setup.welcome.title: Welcome 👋
setup.welcome.text:
In a few steps, we will connect the app to your **mailbox** (the same account as in Thunderbird) and set where the data will be stored.

You can add more mailboxes later under *Settings*. Everything can be changed there as well.
setup.data.title: Where should the data be stored?
setup.data.subtitle: A folder that both Windows and Linux can access.
setup.data.text: So that Windows **and** Linux can use the same list, the folder should be on a **shared partition** (e.g., an NTFS data drive). On the other system, you will simply select the same folder later.
setup.data.fast_startup: **Important for Dual-Boot:** If fast startup is enabled in Windows, Linux can only read the Windows partitions. Turn it off under *Control Panel → Power Options → Choose what happens when you press the power button → Turn on fast startup*.
setup.data.found_existing: Existing data found - only passwords and Thunderbird profile are missing.

template.confirmation.subject: Your Registration: {{ title }} on {{ date_short }}
template.confirmation.html:
Hello {{ first_name }},

great to have you there{{ companions_text }}! Here are all the details at a glance:

{{ details }}

I've attached the event as a calendar entry - just open it and add it to your calendar.

I look forward to seeing you there!
template.rejection.subject: Re: {{ title }}
template.rejection.html:
Hello {{ first_name }},

thank you for your interest in „{{ title }}“. Unfortunately, I cannot offer you a spot for this event.

Best regards,
